name: Brother
title: Brother Sewing Machines UK: Range, History and Parts
description: Brother sewing machines explained: Japanese roots, domestic, embroidery and industrial ranges, who each suits, and where to find parts and servicing.
intro: One of the broadest ranges in sewing, from simple beginner machines to embroidery machines and industrial equipment.
cardText: Japanese roots, domestic and embroidery ranges, industrial machines.

sections.html: Brother traces its roots to a sewing machine repair business founded in Nagoya, Japan, in 1908. The company grew into a manufacturer of sewing machines and later of printers and many other products.

Brother’s domestic range runs from compact mechanical machines to computerised models with many stitches, automatic needle threaders and one-step buttonholes. They are a common first machine in UK homes.
Brother is well known for embroidery and combination sewing-and-embroidery machines. Check the maximum hoop size and the design file formats each model accepts.
Brother also makes industrial sewing machines used in workrooms and factories, alongside its domestic range.

sections.h2: Parts and servicing for Brother machines
sections.html:
